prompt: A hooded ranger in weathered leaf-green and brown leather crouches low in three-quarter view on a forest trail, one hand reaching into a thicket of ferns. A massive scaled green serpent-beast rears up out of the undergrowth in answer to her call, jaws parting, its body coiled among the roots. Wisps of pale green light thread from her fingers to the creature. The background is dense old-growth forest, moss-slicked trunks and deep emerald shadow. The only source of light is the green glow.

A druid in deep emerald and moss-green robes kneels in side profile on the floor of an old-growth forest, one bare hand pressed flat to the mossy earth, calling. In answer, a great antlered stag with shaggy brown fur steps out of the dense ferns toward him, its eyes glowing faint green. Tendrils of soft green summoning light rise from the hand and wreath the stag. The background is a wall of towering moss-slicked tree trunks and shafts of green canopy light. The only source of light is the green magical glow.

A druid in deep emerald and moss-green robes kneels in side profile on the floor of an old-growth forest, one bare hand raised and open, glowing with a bright green orb of summoning light. In answer, a great antlered stag with shaggy brown fur strides out of the dense ferns toward the open hand, its eyes glowing faint green, tendrils of green light wreathing its antlers. The background is a wall of towering moss-slicked tree trunks and shafts of green canopy light. The only source of light is the green magical glow.

The background is deep old-growth forest, moss-slicked trunks fading into emerald shadow. The only source of light is the green glow of the book and the conjured beast.
